items.title: Catherine Russell interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, October 26, 2018
items.q: And actually John Herrington, who plays with Steely Dan was also in that band. That’s where I met him.

ctx.x: Well yeah but I was basically with one band. And they were really fun I mean at that point. Because they weren’t like a top 40 band. I didn’t know any of the top 40. They were basically a standards, jazz standards and Motown and then some soul stuff. So I

knew that stuff. But they were fun people to be with. And actually John Herrington, who plays with Steely Dan was also in that band. That’s where I met him. So we were fun. But some of the other bands, you know they were very good musicians — but some of the other bands, the musicians, the level of musicianship was all over the place, or they could play one type of music and not the other. This band could play all styles. They could play jazz, they could play soul music, they could do everything. But I didn’t…
